items.synopsis: Traffic loss is seen when a MAC moves from dot1x port to non-dot1x port
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms is having dot1x enabled interface. When two or more MAC addresses are learnt on a dot1x port, and if one of them is shifted to a non-dot1x port, the MAC address that was moved is still seen as a MAC-based VLAN entry on the Layer2 Address Learning Manager (l2alm). This could lead to network traffic being lost.

items.synopsis: Traffic blackholing is observed when removing the BGP routes take a long time to get removed from RIB
items.description: On Junos platforms, if a BGP (Border Gateway Protocol) peer is going down and stays down and the system might take an extremely long time to complete removing the BGP routes. The issue observed when a BGP peer sends many routes, only a small amount of routes are selected as the active routes in the RIB (Routing Information Base), and if the BGP delete job gets only a small part of the CPU time as other work in the routing process utilize the CPU.

items.category: Gnats category for dynamic rendering infrastructure
items.synopsis: Invalid XML output in rpc response
items.description: If the configured data has special characters in it, then rpc get output will not escape these special characters and display the data as it is. For example, if we have configured qos class as , then ---- > the response should have default as response value

items.synopsis: VRRPv3 node sends a neighbor advertisement with the wrong virtual MAC
items.description: On all Junos Evolved platforms, when a client sends a neighbor solicitation, the VRRPv3(Virtual Router Redundancy Protocol) node replies with neighbor advertisement and virtual MAC of the wrong interface. There can be some traffic drop because of incorrect virtual MAC entry.

items.synopsis: Few protocol sessions remain down after quick arpd process disable and enable
items.description: Few protocol sessions remain down causing traffic loss in certain prefixes after quick arpd process disable and enable. The system can be recovered from erroneous state by executing "restart routing gracefully" in CLI.

items.synopsis: The FPC can go to a fault state on certain Junos Evolved PTX platforms after system reboot
items.description: On certain Junos Evolved PTX platforms FPC (Flexible PIC concentrator) goes to a fault state after a system reboots with a Major alarm - Power Failure. This issue is a rare issue and the FPC in a fault state will impact the data traffic. To recover from this issue the impacted FPCs need to be rebooted.

items.synopsis: Unable to upgrade Junos using NetConf or Junos script
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms, if RPC get-configuration is invoked before RPC request-package-add in the same session of the NETCONF or Junos script, RPC request-package-add will not work.

items.category: EVO Services Sflow PRs for defect & enhancement requests
items.synopsis: The VLAN-id mapping is incorrect in sflow scenario on PTX Junos OS Evolved platforms
items.description: On PTX Junos OS Evolved platforms, the VLAN-id (Virtual Local Area Network) and priority values are not reset and are getting used for the next packet that was processed by sflow (Sampled Flow) process.

items.category: EVO VXLAN PFE for BCM XGS Platforms
items.synopsis: The ECMP routing table does not get updated when underlay L3 interface link flaps in EVPN-VXLAN scenario
items.description: On all Junos Evolved QFX5130/QFX5700 switches, in an EVPN-VXLAN (Ethernet Virtual Private LAN - Virtual Extensible LAN) deployment, Type-2 Overlay ECMP (Equal Cost Multi Path) routing does not happen when the underlay Layer 3 interface is flapped.

items.synopsis: FPC-JNP10K-LC1201 reset due to evo-aftmand-bt exited when testing GRES in a Label Edge Router role.
items.description: With GRES on a PTX running Junos EVO, the current Label Edge Router role's scaling is suggested to be at 32, 000 LSPs. When the number of LSPs get closers to 60, 000 entries, the LC1201 evo-aftmand-bt process may run out of memory which causes the process to exit and the FPC restarts.

items.synopsis: ACX :: s-map programmed on IFD is not correct when both TCP amd TCP-REM is configured together.
items.description: When TCP Main and TCP remaining attached together on IFD its observed that Improper Scheduler MAP is getting configured on HQoS IFD while sched params modification and bind performed on same commit. This is a sequence issue from CoSD(RE) which not guaranteed at PFE side. And this applicable for all platforms.

items.synopsis: Some VPLS and L2VPN streams are dropped on the AE interface after a change in MTU configuration on the AE interface
items.description: On all Junos OS Evolved platforms the MTU change on the LAG interface triggers an interface flap leading to ECMP next-hop modification. When this issue happens some of the Layer 2 Virtual Private Network (L2VPN) and Virtual Private LAN Services (VPLS) flows may get dropped. The issue is not observed consistently.

items.synopsis: JDI-RCT: ACX/AMX:Guardian: Local route itself reject
items.description: Disable and Enable IRB interface will resolve the issue.

items.category: Gnats category for dynamic rendering infrastructure
items.synopsis: The picd and evoaftmand process crash is seen in telemetry scenario
items.description: The picd and evoaftmand process will crash by unsubscribing /component or /interface sensor on certain platforms which uses telemetry infra.

items.synopsis: Junos Evolved - fibd object-info anomalies observed@net:: juniper:: addrwatch:: AddrWatchNotify
items.description: On a system running Junos Evolved software with GRES configured. The fibd process may not free object memories after they are no longer needed. This causes an error message such as "object-info anomalies observed".

items.synopsis: When the SPF algorithm for IS-IS in Segment Routing use case is triggered frequently, CPU usage might increase
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms, when the shortest-path-first (SPF) algorithm for IS-IS is triggered frequently, CPU usage might increase and impact the device performance and traffic.

items.synopsis: BNG Controller: L2TP LAC functionality is not working in this release
items.description: L2TP LAC functionality is not working in this release
